passage.text: Thank you for your application to spend a semester at our university in Toronto as an exchange student.
passage.reading: ˈθæŋk juː fər jʊr ˌæplɪˈkeɪʃən tə ˈspɛnd ə səˈmɛstər ət aʊr ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti ɪn təˈrɑːntoʊ əz ən ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ ˌstuːdənt.

passage.text: We are happy to tell you that we have accepted your application for the fall semester.
passage.reading: wiː ər ˈhæpi tə ˈtɛl juː ðæt wiː hæv əkˈsɛptɪd jʊr ˌæplɪˈkeɪʃən fər ðə ˈfɔːl səˈmɛstər.

passage.text: Before you arrive, please send us your English test certificate.
passage.reading: bɪˈfɔːr juː əˈraɪv, ˈpliːz ˈsɛnd ʌs jʊr ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈtɛst sərˈtɪfɪkət.

passage.text: You also need to enroll in your courses online by July 15.
passage.reading: juː ˈɔːlsoʊ ˈniːd tə ɪnˈroʊl ɪn jʊr ˈkɔːrsɪz ˌɑːnˈlaɪn baɪ dʒuˈlaɪ ˌfɪfˈtiːnθ.

passage.text: Our website explains how to do this.
passage.reading: aʊr ˈwɛbsaɪt ɪkˈspleɪnz ˈhaʊ tə ˈduː ˈðɪs.
ˌɔːriɛnˈteɪʃən ˈwiːk ˈstɑːrts ɑːn sɛpˈtɛmbər ˈsɛkənd.

passage.text: During orientation, you will meet other exchange students, get your student ID card and take a tour of the campus.
passage.reading: ˈdʊrɪŋ ˌɔːriɛnˈteɪʃən, juː wɪl ˈmiːt ˈʌðər ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ ˌstuːdənts, ˈɡɛt jʊr ˈstuːdənt ˌaɪˈdiː ˌkɑːrd ənd ˈteɪk ə ˈtʊr əv ðə ˈkæmpəs.

passage.text: All new students have to attend.
passage.reading: ˈɔːl ˈnuː ˈstuːdənts ˈhæf tə əˈtɛnd.

passage.text: If you have any questions, please reply to this email.
passage.reading: ɪf juː ˈhæv ˈɛni ˈkwɛstʃənz, ˈpliːz rɪˈplaɪ tə ˈðɪs ˈiːmeɪl.

passage.text: We look forward to meeting you in Toronto.
passage.reading: wiː ˈlʊk ˈfɔːrwərd tə ˈmiːtɪŋ juː ɪn təˈrɑːntoʊ.
